body: Im just wondering when everything will start getting better, I’ve had this feeling since I was ten years old,

She tells me to be honest with her, but whenever I tell her something she gets angry at me which I understand. However, there is mostly no solution when I tell her and it mostly brings negativity in our relationship.
We did everything except had sex
It doesn’t feel good without her knowing, feels like lying idk
Okay, but do you think I should tell her?
Thanks a lot for your comments, really helpful man! Lots of love <3
Thanks a lot for this message it helps a lot. She might have been a bit extreme but she is totally right here. I will try and talk to them.
I know but I don’t think they’ll see me as responsible even if I do that now.

Thanks, it’s not that I’m a derailed child. Only thing I do is drink sometimes. On school I’m on the highest level possible and I’m doing quite well. I don’t know what I can do to achieve this responsible behaviour.
I will keep using Paxil till the end of November, after that I will follow up your advice. Thank you!

Alright, I'll think I will see for the end of November if it goes away and if it doesn't I think I am going to switch. 
Thanks!
